77	class ContradictionDetector:
78	    def detect(self, resolutions: list[Resolution]) -> list[Contradiction]:
79	        by_category: dict[str, list[Resolution]] = {}
80	        for r in resolutions:
81	            by_category.setdefault(r.question.category, []).append(r)
82	
83	        contradictions = []
84	        for rule in CONTRADICTION_RULES:
85	            c = self._check_rule(rule, by_category)
86	            if c:
87	                contradictions.append(c)
88	        return contradictions

90	    def _check_rule(self, rule: dict, by_cat: dict) -> Optional[Contradiction]:
91	        cat_a = rule.get("category_a", "")
92	        cat_b = rule.get("category_b", "")
93	        items_a = by_cat.get(cat_a, [])
94	        items_b = by_cat.get(cat_b, [])
95	
96	        if not items_a or not items_b:
97	            return None
98	
99	        a_match = self._matches_pattern(items_a, rule)
100	        b_match = self._matches_pattern_b(items_b, rule)
101	
102	        if a_match and b_match:
103	            return Contradiction(
104	                atom_a=a_match.question.text,
105	                atom_b=b_match.question.text,
106	                rule=rule["description"],
107	                severity=rule["severity"],
108	            )
109	        return None
110	
111	    def _matches_pattern(self, items: list[Resolution], rule: dict) -> Optional[Resolution]:
112	        pattern = rule.get("pattern_a", "")
113	        threshold = rule.get("pattern_a_threshold")
114	
115	        for item in items:
116	            if not item.answer:
117	                continue
118	            if threshold is not None:
119	                try:
120	                    parts = item.answer.split("%")[0].split(":")
121	                    rate_str = parts[-1].strip().rstrip("%")
122	                    rate = float(rate_str)
123	                    if rate >= threshold:
124	                        return item
125	                except (ValueError, IndexError):
126	                    pass
127	            elif pattern and pattern.lower() in item.answer.lower():
128	                return item
129	        return None

132	        pattern = rule.get("pattern_b", "")
133	        min_count = rule.get("pattern_b_min_count")
134	
135	        for item in items:
